title: ODNI nine-month operation against whistleblowers and journalists
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of ODNI nine-month operation against whistleblowers and journalists, about 2025-2026 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I just want you to know that ODNI ran an operation for 9 months.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who reports on UFO claims, says that the ODNI, the office that oversees all US spy agencies, ran a nine-month operation around 2025 and 2026. He links it to whistleblowers and journalists such as George Knapp, Dylan Borland and Matthew Brown, and to the office's head, Tulsi Gabbard. If true, it would mean the intelligence world was actively working against the people speaking out about UFOs.
